stage_b_reviewed_content.statement:
Let $S$ be a scheme. Let $B$ be an algebraic space over $S$.
Let $G$ be a group algebraic space over $B$. Then the stacks
in groupoids
$$
[B/G],\quad
[[B/G]],\quad
G\textit{-Torsors},\quad
\mathcal{G}/\mathcal{B}\textit{-Torsors}
$$
are all canonically equivalent.
If $G \to B$ is flat and locally
of finite presentation, then these are also equivalent to
$G\textit{-Principal}$.

reason: The source composes the previously established equivalences between sheaf torsors, algebraic-space torsors, and quotient stacks. For flat locally finitely presented G->B, an fpqc-locally trivial principal space X->U is surjective, flat, lfp, and admits an etale scheme cover W->X, producing an fppf trivializing cover W->U.
